name: Calm-DVOL trend grind — low implied vol x strong ADX trend (long spot)
rationale: CROSS-METRIC (dvol x adx). The one existing DVOL-calm spec gates RAW MOMENTUM (ret_Nd) by low DVOL. This gates a different, complementary trend primitive: ADX trend STRENGTH. Low crypto-native implied vol (calm options regime) plus a STRONG, established directional trend (high ADX) is the 'orderly markup' regime where trend-following compounds with minimal whipsaw — the options market is pricing calm AND the price structure is cleanly trending, two orthogonal confirmations (implied-vol regime vs realized-trend-quality) of the same favorable weather. Mechanism before data: long spot when dvol is below a fitted calm ceiling AND adx is above a fitted trend-strength floor AND a short ret confirms the trend is UP (ADX is direction-agnostic, so a positive-return arm pins the long side); exit when ADX weakens or DVOL spikes (regime broke) via barriers. Distinct from dvol-calm-regime-momentum (dvol + ret_Nd, no ADX), adx-trend-follow (ADX + ret_Nd, no implied-vol regime), and theory-calm-regime-momentum (realized ATR, not implied DVOL). Disconfirmer 1: drop the dvol arm — if bare ADX-trend-following matches the deflated Sharpe, the implied-vol regime adds nothing (it duplicates the ADX spec). Disconfirmer 2: drop the ADX arm — if dvol-calm + momentum matches, it duplicates the existing dvol spec. The edge must require BOTH. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): DVOL daily next-day-available; net of ~20bps the grind must clear. tier0 dvol + tier0 adx/ret, fresh DVOL prod data, unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: low crypto implied vol (dvol calm) WHILE a strong directional trend (high ADX) is rising — an orderly markup, ridden on spot
